name: PotaLang
description: A language-learning app (Expo / React Native) with Pota the potato and his veggie friends: courses from A1 to C2 in six languages, a story mode, games like Veggie Slice, and recorded character voices.

name: Game1
description:
🎮 Game Concept Document
Paste this into Claude Code along with your generated image.

Game Title: Swarm Survivor (working title)
Genre
Top-down 3D casual mobile shooter / horde survival

Camera & View
Top-down 3D perspective looking down at the action
Low-poly, colorful, cartoonish art style (see attached image)
Vertical mobile orientation
Core Concept
The player controls a swarm of identical clone characters that move together as one single unit. The clone count acts as both your firepower and your health. You clear zombie hordes by moving and rotating your swarm around the map, collecting upgrades, and surviving until you reach and defeat the boss.

Controls
Left joystick: Move the entire swarm (all clones follow the player position in a tight formation)
Right joystick: Aim direction (clones shoot in that direction)
Clones auto-fire when enemies are in range
Clones (Your "Health" & Army)
You start each level with 1 clone
Clones are identical copies of the player character
They move together as one blob/formation around the player
No health bar exists — your clone count IS your health
When a zombie touches a clone, that clone dies instantly and disappears
0 clones = Game Over
Pickups (Scattered on the map)
"+N" Orbs (e.g., +5, +10, +20): Instantly duplicate your clones by that number
Weapon Crates: Upgrade ALL clones' weapons at once (pistol → shotgun → machine gun → rocket launcher, etc.)
Enemies
Zombies: Simple low-poly green enemies that walk toward the swarm
They spawn in waves from the edges of the map
Different types: slow walkers, fast runners, big tanks
One touch = one clone dies (for all zombie types)
Level Flow
Start alone with a pistol
Kill zombies, collect "+N" orbs to grow your swarm
Collect weapon crates to upgrade all clones at once
Move and rotate your swarm around the map clearing hordes
Survive waves of increasing difficulty
Reach the boss at the end of the level
Kill the boss to win the level
Boss
Appears at the end of each level
Much bigger than regular zombies
Has a visible health bar (the ONLY health bar in the game)
Attacks by charging and spawning mini-zombies
Defeating the boss = Level Complete
Technical Constraints
Must run on old/low-end phones
Use free assets (Kenney.nl, itch.io, etc.)
Keep 3D models low-poly and simple
No heavy shaders, no complex particles, no post-processing
Optimize for performance: object pooling for bullets and zombies
